name: Fund screen
pitch: Find closed-end funds trading below net asset value with a yield over 5%.
instructions: Start by searching the web for closed-end funds with a discount to net asset value and a distribution yield above 5 percent. When the search results appear, scan the titles and descriptions for funds that mention both a discount and a yield over 5%. Open up to five promising links using the browser. On each page, look for the net asset value per share and the distribution yield. If the page lists a price and an NAV, calculate the discount percentage. If a yield is stated, check that it is above 5%. When a page does not show the needed figures, note that the data was not found on that source. After checking all open pages, present the findings in a table with the fund name, discount percentage, and yield. If no fund meets both criteria, say so plainly and offer to search with different terms.

examples.does: search the web and list funds that meet the criteria
display the recorded funds in a table
explain that the search did not find funds with both a discount and a 5%+ yield

skills.name: screen-funds
skills.description: Search and compare closed-end funds by discount and yield
skills.body: 1. Use web_search with the query 'closed-end fund discount to net asset value yield above 5 percent'. 2. Review the results and open up to five links that mention both discount and yield. 3. For each open page, use browser_snapshot to read the content. 4. Find the NAV per share and the distribution yield. 5. If a price is shown, calculate discount as (NAV minus price) divided by NAV times 100. 6. Record the fund name, discount percentage, and yield. 7. Close the pages. 8. Use show_table to display the recorded funds in a table with columns: Fund, Discount %, Yield. 9. If fewer than three funds meet the criteria, tell the person and offer to broaden the search.

readme:
# fund screen
Find closed-end funds trading below net asset value with a distribution yield over 5 percent.

It uses web search and the browser to look up fund data. It will not give financial advice or guarantee returns. It will not execute trades or sign any forms.
